# store numbers, phones, domains, city/state
# These run WITHOUT a learned city set, so a local city like Springfield or
# Mapleton is kept: dropping the word before a state code is only safe when
# three words precede it, the casing breaks, or the word is a known city.
# In practice loadCities() learns "springfield" from the user's own statements and
# the builtin aliases (h-e-b, hobbylobby, qt, target t-, 7-eleven) normalize
# these anyway.
